text: Practical psychology is a branch of the discipline that applies psychological theories and methods to solve real-world problems. It focuses on analyzing individual and group behaviors through the principles of psychological science and provides solutions for fields such as education, clinical practice, organizational management, and social services. The course aims to cultivate students' mastery of basic psychological theories, equip them with practical abilities in psychological assessment, intervention design and data statistical analysis, and cultivate them into professional talents with both scientific and practical qualities.
